result_semantics.PASS: All required local evidence and point-in-time predicates were independently checked. This does not approve a valuation, strategy, performance claim, order, portfolio action, or production operation.
result_semantics.FAIL: A concrete contradiction was found, including future evidence, hash mismatch, path escape, malformed evidence, or inconsistent declared state.
result_semantics.NOT_PROVEN: Required evidence or proof structure is absent. Missing proof never upgrades to PASS.

information_cutoff.date_only_rule: A date-only publication is not available until the exclusive next-day boundary at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai.
information_cutoff.future_rule: Evidence available after a decision cutoff cannot prove that decision.
